action_items: forecast-recommendations and csv-import-export initially failed due test assertions (strict duplicate text locator and transient toast text); each passed after one script correction/rerun and is classified flaky per policy.

checks.criterion: Autenticação demo com perfis administrador e operador
checks.name: demo-auth-profiles
checks.evidence: UI login accepted admin and operator credentials; role badge showed Administrador then Operador.

checks.criterion: Autenticação demo com perfis administrador e operador
checks.name: test_tscheck_auth
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/login returned 200 for both demo roles; invalid password returned 401; /api/auth/me returned 200.

checks.name: admin-login-dashboard
checks.evidence: Public preview rendered KPI cards, demand chart, replenishment alerts, stock health, and recent movements after login.

checks.name: test_tscheck_dashboard
checks.evidence: GET /api/dashboard returned 200 with KPI fields, stock_distribution, 7 demand points, critical_products, and recent_movements.

checks.name: admin-creates-product
checks.evidence: Admin created TSCHECK-UI-PRODUCT and its table row displayed SKU and Saudável status.

checks.name: test_tscheck_products
checks.evidence: POST /api/products returned 200 for a unique fixture and GET /api/products contained its returned id; duplicate SKU returned 409.

checks.name: movement-updates-history
checks.evidence: UI registered a tscheck ui entrada movement and displayed the reason in movement history.

checks.name: test_tscheck_movements
checks.evidence: POST /api/movements returned 200; GET /api/products showed created fixture stock increased; negative stock returned 422.

checks.name: forecast-recommendations
checks.evidence: Initial run hit strict-mode duplicate text assertion; corrected exact heading assertion and rerun passed model explanation, recommendations table, and 30-day selector.

checks.name: test_tscheck_forecast
checks.evidence: GET /api/forecast?days=7,15,30,60 returned 200 with model name; invalid 8-day horizon returned 422.

checks.name: operator-role-permissions
checks.evidence: Operator UI showed products without Novo produto, and import dropzone disabled with admin-only message.

checks.name: test_tscheck_permissions
checks.evidence: Operator GET /api/products and /api/dashboard returned 200; POST /api/products and POST /api/import/products returned 403.

checks.name: csv-import-export
checks.evidence: Initial run did not observe transient toast text; corrected flow asserted download, preview, 200 import response, and imported fixture row on rerun.

checks.name: test_tscheck_import
checks.evidence: Admin POST /api/import/products returned 200 with imported=1 and GET /api/products contained the imported fixture SKU.

checks.criterion: Responsividade e ausência de erros críticos
checks.name: responsive-main-flow
checks.evidence: Desktop 1280x720 login, dashboard, theme toggle, and products navigation rendered without blank screen; screenshot captured.
